subject: [PATCH 12/60] mm/vmscan: restrict reclaim to common memory

reviews.author: Gregory Price (Meta)
reviews.summary: The patch series introduces a new approach to memory management by restricting reclaim operations to common memory nodes. This change is expected to improve system performance and reduce unnecessary reclaim activities.

2026-11-20.patch_summary: This patch series aims to restrict reclaim operations to common memory nodes, improving the efficiency of memory management in Linux. The changes involve modifying kswapd and direct reclaim to only operate on common nodes, using first_node_state() and next_node_state() instead of first_memory_node and next_memory_node. This approach is expected to reduce unnecessary reclaim activities and improve system performance.
